output.brief: The rejects come from an interaction. Arnholt resin arrives wetter than Quillan, and dryer D5 no longer dries properly. Wet resin cracks latches and causes splay. Arnholt in D5 on Press 5 rejects about 10%. Arnholt on Press 7 (good dryer) runs 0.8%. Quillan in D5 runs 0.9%. Arnholt dried in a good dryer and fed to Press 5 gave 0.8%. The second-shift gap exists only because all second-shift VX runs on Press 5. New and experienced operators score the same, so don't discipline the six. Dropping Arnholt isn't needed. Maintenance saying the dryers are fine is wrong: the D5 alarm limit was loosened in week 31. This week: keep Arnholt off D5 and route it to Press 7 or a verified dryer. Repair D5's heater and desiccant, confirm −40 °C, restore the alarm limit, and add a feed-throat moisture check for every lot. Tell the customer in the 8D about this. Open question: whether the annex storage makes Arnholt wetter. That is confounded with the supplier, so check the incoming moisture before paying to move the octabins.
